description: Custom regex rules for automated book categorization. Syntax: '<field> =~ /<pattern>/<flags> -> <Category>/<Subcategory>'
rules: title =~ /principles.*chem|general chemistry|inorganic chemistry|kacem|مبادئ الكيمياء|chimie/i -> Chemistry/Inorganic & Physical Chemistry
title =~ /machine learning|deep learning|neural network|artificial intelligence/i -> Computer Science/Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
title =~ /algorithm|data structure|graph theory/i -> Computer Science/Algorithms & Data Structures
title =~ /operating system|distributed system|database internal|compiler/i -> Computer Science/Systems & Architecture
title =~ /clean code|design pattern|software architecture|refactoring/i -> Computer Science/Software Engineering
title =~ /linear algebra|matrix|abstract algebra/i -> Mathematics/Linear Algebra & Abstract Algebra
